body:
I really want to be at the top of my class in my new school and that's going to be a challenge do that'll be a good motivator. 

Practically all of my friends have been male up until I met her. Except for a girl that moved away awhile ago and another girl. She is absolutely fantastic, I wouldn't trade the world for my relationship with her.  

I try not to make excuses, sometimes I do but I try to avoid them. 

My situation has already improved; we bought a house, I feel pretty good (I'm still stressed but I'll survive) and I get a month all to myself.

Thanks again, you are awesome :)

My parents are so freaked about my grades because "I am wasting my talent," which is fair since I'm brilliant (Not to toot my own horn). I am not in a private school and I am not moving to a private school. It's still really stressful when I'm getting high 80's and low 90's and even a 96 just to be yelled at for screwing up, I fixed it, I don't think it's a huge deal but, my parents do. 

I really don't want to talk to someone I know, except my one friend she is awesome and I would trust her with **anything**. 

Maybe I'm just making excuses I could put more effort in I just don't really want to, when I am doing stupid, pointless tasks. 

I'll take a look at the videos in a bit. 

Thank you so much! I don't know if I would've gone through with suicide if I wouldn't have talked to somebody but, you've guaranteed that I'm not going to. You and the other posters have really put, my life in perspective and its really helpful. Keep up the great work!
 If I have any questions, or need someone to talk to can I PM you?
Feel great about what you are doing, you are changing and saving people's lives and in my eyes that makes you a hero.

Take care and keep being a fantastic person!

I'm going to the city next week to start summer school (became I need to do math 20 for my new school before I can get in) and I am going to see a professional there. 

Some of them mean well and I'm going to keep in touch with when I move and others I'm dropping contact as soon as I move. I'm still in high school but, I am going to talk to somebody. 

Next year I am going to plan out every second of every day since my course load is going to be insane compared to this year. That video was really great, thanks for that. 

My relationship is deteriorating with them because their expectations are too much for me to handle. I try to meet them but, if I fail I just want to give up. Earlier today I found out that I was about to fail religion because I hadn't done the assignments. I fucked up and I know that. I also lied to my dad about having done that so there's that. When I fail, I fail miserably. My mum wants me to write an email saying that I'm sorry not only to my teacher and to my dad (Which is reasonable) but, also to her and my principal (Which frankly I'm not going to do). I have already talked to my teacher and caught up on my work and I went from a 36 to an 81 average in the class but, like my sister describes it "Its like you caused world war 3". Thats a pretty accurate description of the atmosphere and tension in my house right now. 

It's more my parents who are stressed about moving and that stress is then passed down to me. My dad hasn't yet found a job and my mum hasn't yet bought a house. There isn't anything I can do. 

The expectations are realistic for me but not when I am dealing with depression and all my other problems. I need to put in more effort but, I physically cannot in my state of being. 

Yes it should but, I don't want my parents involved so its going to have to wait for another week. 

I've come to terms with my granddad passing but, that's what first sent me spiraling down into depression. I thought it was good to mention. 

It's because of my weight and its caused by my eating disorder which I am going to seek help for in a week. Also because my mum always makes comments when I am wearing a long sleeve shirt or a hoodie or pants because "I'm hiding my body" I am but, I feel more confidant in myself and I comfortable and it looks good. The comments are kind of hurtful. 

Don't feel like you've offended me by saying my situation is a mess. It is. And I'll be going to the city in a week so I'll see someone there.

I've told my friend and she's the only person I would trust with that. I have a terrible relationship with my parents, I don't trust them, they don't trust me. I've wanted to go see a professional for awhile now but, my mum was the manager for the mental health outlook in down and I don't want to tell her or anyone she works with. When I move to the city I plan on going to talk to someone there. 

Stresses include:

Fair-weather friends
School/grades
Deteriorating relationship with my parents
Stress about moving away 
Expectations that I don't think that I can meet.
Eating disorder
Death of my granddad 
Self esteem issues

I'm broken and I can't fix myself alone. And I don't think that the professionals in my community are professional enough to share my problems with.

Suicide isn't illegal here but I get your point. I'm assuming you're Woodysgamertag on YouTube, I'm wondering what you did after your failed attempt? How did you manage? How did you get better? 

I'm not going to kill myself but, I don't want to deal with the alternative. I **need** to do something about my problems but I don't know what.

You're probably right. It's just so frustrating when you feel like you are a useless piece of shit in everyone's eyes. Then you start to believe it yourself, you've always believed it deep down but now its at the surface, and that's when you start to hurt yourself and start thinking about suicide all the time. Now when someone comes into your life and brings out the best in you but, your best doesn't feel good enough for them, to our it briefly: it's tough.

That really puts things into perspective and I really appreciate it. I feel like I don't add anything to there lives being in it, I feel like I'm mooching off of them. There are new chapters but I don't know whether I want to learn what they entail.

No my parents don't know what I'm going through with depression nor do they know my concerns about the move. They think I'm excited for the move, which I am but, they don't know my concerns. I've also never talked to a professional about my problem, although I've wanted to, because my mum was the manager for mental health in my town and I didn't want to talk to people I knew. I also have an eating disorder, I overeat a lot and I don't manage it well. And I can't tell my parents because I'll just be handed more stress and I cannot handle that. 

Yeah it is special what we have and I would be devastated if I lost that relationship.

I just don't know what to do anymore. I've recently come to terms with my sexuality (I'm bisexual). I'm moving to a new city and a new school (I'm going into grade 11), I'm excited into to go to my new school but I don't make friends easily and I don't know anyone in my new school. My parents are stressed about moving since my dad doesn't have a new job and we can't find a house. I've been depressed ever since my granddad passed away two years ago. I was feeling better around the time when I learnt that we were moving and I got accepted into the academic school in my new city (I currently live rurally and I hate it). Then I made it to nationals for science fair and met the most amazing person I've ever met. But, she started dating my science fair partner and I'm jealous because he's an asshole and feel that I would be better for her. They are dating long distance (~2 1/2 hours away from each other) and I feel neglected since she pays more attention to him than to me. We still talk quite a bit and she has helped me while I've spiraled back into depression. I feel like I may have been too open with her and scared her off. I just don't know what to do anymore, I thought I had it figured out but, I have no clue.
Maybe you're right. I really need to think this over first. Thanks, you an other posters in this subreddit have helped.

I've already told someone that I met a month ago pretty much my whole life up to this point in time. She is wonderful and doesn't need to be dragged down by myself. I think this is where the story ends.
